dialogue.speaker: Claire
dialogue.text: Bonjour ! Un café, s'il vous plaît.
dialogue.shot: Inside a cozy Parisian café at the counter, Claire is ordering, Shohista stands next to her looking curious.

dialogue.speaker: Shohista
dialogue.text: «Bonjour ! Un café, s'il vous plaît.» [bonjur, an kafe, sil vu ple] «S'il vous plaît» — "iltimos" degani. Har bir iltimosdan keyin ayting!
dialogue.shot: Same café, Shohista turns to the viewer and explains with her index finger raised, Claire holds a coffee cup.

dialogue.speaker: Claire
dialogue.shot: In front of a glass pastry display full of croissants, Claire points at the croissants.

dialogue.speaker: Shohista
dialogue.text: «Et avec ça ?» [e avek sa] — sotuvchi doim so'raydi: "Yana nimadir?" Javob: «Oui, merci !» [ui, mersi] — "Ha, rahmat!"
dialogue.shot: Shohista laughs holding a croissant, Claire smiles.

dialogue.speaker: Claire
dialogue.shot: At the café cash register, Claire holds her wallet.

dialogue.speaker: Shohista
dialogue.text: «C'est combien ?» [se kombyen] — narxni so'rashning eng oson yo'li. Endi Parijda och qolmaysiz!
dialogue.shot: Both girls sit at a café terrace table with the Eiffel Tower in the background, happy.

tip_uz: Fransiyada kafega kirganda avval «Bonjour» deng — bu juda muhim odob!
